text:
Maria - CS: Quick heads up — AtlasWave go-live target: Tue 09:00 PT. Need to finalize quota + autoscale plan and schedule a smoke+stress load test. Any blockers?

Ben - SRE: Are they on Reserved Dedicated or Dedicated burst?

Maria - CS: Reserved Dedicated (customer committed). Initial bump = 2x A100 equiv. We want steady 600 RPS for normal traffic, allow bursts up to 1200 for short windows (max 30m).

Jamila - Solutions: Their product has lots of repeated prompts; we should consider KV/prefix priming before traffic shift. Also will need an enablement doc for on-call.

Alex - Platform: Plan for staged tests: ramp -> steady -> spike. Suggest: ramp to 600 over 20m, hold 15m, spike to 1200 for 10m, cool down. Canary route to 10% first, then 50%, then 100%. Fallback route to model-v1-small when latency > 1.2s.

Ben - SRE: Autoscale knobs: set cooldown to 90s, target utilization 65% per replica, max replicas = 8. Token bucket quota should allow burst buffer: set burst_limit = 1400 so we don't throttle expected spikes. Also ensure healthcheck endpoints for model runtime are green before shift.

Maria - CS: OK. Can we run the loadtest this Friday 02:00 PT? Need results for Monday exec review.

Alex - Platform: I can run it. Test script (will run in staging-pool):

```
./tools/loadtest --env staging --target 600 --ramp 20m --hold 15m --spike 1200 --spike-duration 10m --cooldown 5m
```

Expected quick checks: p95 latency, p99 latency, GPU util, KV cache hit rate, and error-rate. I'll post metrics after run.

deploy-bot: loadtest-job/atlaswave-stress-172222 started in staging (job id: loadtest-172222) :rocket:

Ben - SRE: During the spike watch for: OOMs, worker restarts, and tail latency. If KV cache hit < 70% we'll see token expansion and p99 blowups. Also keep an eye on compaction pauses on host 7.

Jamila - Solutions: I'll draft the enablement checklist and customer-facing runbook (what to expect during burst, who to call). I'll also collect a set of 20 canonical prompts for regression checks.

Maria - CS: Noted. Also flagging renewal risk: if sustained errors > 0.5% during the first 24h we should trigger a customer success touchpoint. Keep that threshold in the runbook.

Alex - Platform: Posting quick sample output from a dry run (abbreviated):

```
[SUMMARY] target=600, duration=40m
p50=110ms p95=420ms p99=980ms errors=0.12% GPUutil=74% KVhit=78%
Spike -> p99 climbed to 1.6s, errors=0.45% during 10m window
```

Ben - SRE: Looks okay but borderline on spike p99. If we see similar in Fri test, we should tweak model routing (shorter context, smaller variant) or increase replicas by +2.

Maria - CS: Action items: @Alex run loadtest Fri 02:00 PT and post metrics; @Ben prepare autoscale + quota change and standby for rolling tweak; @Jamila produce enablement doc + 20 prompts by Friday; I'll coordinate customer comms and escalation play.

Ben - SRE: I'll also add a temporary alert: "AtlasWave dedicated errors > 0.5% over 5m" to paging policy.

Jamila - Solutions: I'll attach the prompts to the runbook and include a short FAQ for the customer about expected latencies during spike.

Maria - CS: Great — thanks. If anything blocks test ops ping me in this thread. :thumbsup:

Alex - Platform: Roger. Will report back after the run.

deploy-bot: loadtest-job/atlaswave-stress-172222 completed (success). Results uploaded to s3://redwood-loadtests/atlaswave/172222/results.json

Alex - Platform: Uploaded metrics and graphs to the run folder. Early look: steady window ok, spike p99 = 1.58s, errors 0.52% during spike (just above threshold). Recommend small rollback to 1.0x model variant for spike route and increase replicas by +1 for initial handoff.

Maria - CS: Copy that. I'll set the customer expectation and trigger the canary with adjusted routing. Follow-up sync Monday 08:30 PT to review handoff and renewal messaging.

Ben - SRE: I'll apply autoscale+quota change tomorrow morning and monitor.

Jamila - Solutions: Runbook + prompts posted to drive, sharing link in Monday sync.

Maria - CS: Thanks team — closing this out for now.
